06A FEW DETAILS

Clear answers.
Before you start.

What is Aether?+

A platform direction for accessing several model families through one API, with unified chat, coding tools and per-token pricing. This page is a product preview: model names, availability and rates are illustrative.

Can I use an OpenAI-compatible SDK?+

The proposed API follows the familiar chat-completions request format. The quickstart shows how a base URL, API key and model string fit together. The example endpoint is a placeholder and does not send live requests.

What do the three model modes mean?+

Standard is the default behavior. Low-refusal and abliterated are alternative model variants intended to reduce refusal behavior. Availability and actual behavior depend on the model; each family lists the modes shown in this preview.

How does prompt caching affect cost?+

In this pricing example, repeated input tokens use the cached-input rate. The estimator separates input, cached input and output so you can see the arithmetic before choosing a model.

Can I change models without rebuilding my integration?+

The examples use the same request structure for every model. Choose a family and an available mode in the quickstart; the model identifier updates in cURL, TypeScript and Python.

Are the prices and subscriptions final?+

No. All model prices and plan amounts here are samples for product exploration. There is no checkout or active billing on this preview.
